chunks.title: Paneer_Handi_Dhaba_style
chunks.text: Hello everyone, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Asma. Today I am going to make Paneer Handi. If you like my recipe then please like and subscribe to my channel. We are going to make Paneer Handi. We will cut the paneer into big pieces. We will use the same quantity of onions and tomatoes. I have cut 2 onions and 2 tomatoes. Now I will tell you how to use it. We are making it in clay pot. We will add some oil in it. If you want you can make it in ghee. But we will add some oil and this is pure ghee. You can also add butter instead of ghee. We will not keep it on high heat. We will keep it on medium flame. Because we are afraid that the clay pot will break. It is a clay pot so it should be heated. Then we will add whole spices in it. Now we will add cumin seeds and whole spices. We will keep the green chilies and black cardamom dry. Now we will add onions in it. We will keep it on medium flame. Do not keep it on high flame. Otherwise it will break. Let it cook. Till the time our onions are getting fried. We have kept 9-10 cashews and tomatoes. We will grind it without water. Now our onions are getting fried. We will add green chilies in it. We will add ginger garlic paste in it. We will add less than 1 spoon. We will remove the raw taste of it. It will get fried and the color will change. We will cook it on medium flame. Now our onions are getting fried. Now we will add dry spices in it. We will add turmeric, salt, red chili and coriander in it. We will add 1 spoon red chili powder. You can add salt and red chili according to your taste. We will add 1 spoon turmeric, 1 spoon coriander and dry fenugreek leaves. We will add all these spices in it. We will mix it well. We will mix it on low flame. Now we will add tomato and cashew paste in it. We will add little water in it. We will mix it well. We will add 1 bell pepper in it. We will mix it well. We will add 1 spoon sugar in it. You can add sugar in it. Because it will balance the taste of the dish. You can add sugar in it. If you don't have sugar. Now we will add 1 cup of milk in it. We will mix it well. Now we will add 1 spoon garam masala in it. We will mix it well. We will add 1 spoon of salt in it. We will mix it well. We will add 1 spoon of turmeric in it. We will add paneer pieces in it. So that all the flavours are mixed well. And it will cook with the gravy. We will stir it gently. So that the paneer pieces don't break. We will stir it gently. Now we will cook it on low flame for 2 minutes. After that we will remove the lid. And we will add fresh cream in it. And we will add fresh coriander in it. Now we will mix it gently. Now we will serve it. If you like my recipe. Then like it. And subscribe to my channel. Thanks for watching. Paneer Khandi
